product_one_liner.value: Naïve provides managed AI agents and business infrastructure for developers and founders to launch and operate autonomous companies end-to-end.

named_customers.notes: No customer case-study page, customer roster, or matching G2/Capterra listing establishing two named customers was found; fictional template demo brands were excluded.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports a team size of 12.

eng_blog.notes: The index has one Engineering post. Other architecture material is categorized as launch or integration content, and two engineer-authored build posts could not be established.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation contains multiple guides and API, SDK and CLI references.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Under the specified title-based test, no listed title includes the qualifying terms. The board does list Founding Member of Technical Staff — RL and Founding Member of Techincal Staff - Agents, both involving LLM/agent work.

model_provider.notes: Explicitly used by Naive Managed Agents in its published benchmarks; this does not establish a fixed production-default model.

compliance_certs.notes: The reviewed legal pages name none of the five requested certifications; general security and EEA/UK privacy provisions are not certifications.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The readable board lists engineering, growth and video-editing roles, but no qualifying SDR, BDR or account-executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: Naive Managed Agents launched in early access on August 17, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The founders remain publicly identified as CEO and CTO, but no complete dated leadership roster or qualifying C-level/VP arrival or departure could be verified for November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The reviewed job board and connection documentation do not name a CRM or sales/marketing system used internally by Naïve. Generic CRM capabilities and customer-deployable templates were not treated as evidence of its internal stack.
